messages:
mira: Heads-up — I merged the sample banks for the new model eval this morning and noticed a provenance mismatch. Several holdout rows lost their source tags after the join, so downstream dedupe/infill steps are misbehaving.

sam: @mira can you paste an example row or a quick diff? is this coming from seedbank merge or the async ingest?

mira: quick repro (redacted):
```
id: 0a9f...
fingerprint: d4b3...
source_id: NULL
orig_source: seedbank/2026-03-19/s-17
```
The orig_source exists but source_id is null after the merge.

mira: command I ran: `python tools/provenance_check.py --snapshot s-2026-03-20 --diff`
sample output: `PROV_MISMATCH: 123 rows with orig_source but missing source_id; 47 fingerprint duplicates across shards`

tony: yikes. that will definitely skew the q4b quant bring-up bench numbers. our eval harness assumes provenance->label mapping is 1:1.

nina: Proposal:
- dry-run provenance-repair to reattach source_id where orig_source present
- run infill to generate missing variant examples only for affected cohorts
- pause labeling queue for the affected cohort id (cohort-gn21) until repair finishes
- snapshot current golden/goldset and canary the repaired snapshot for regressions
If everyone agrees I can open the rollback/exec ticket.

labeler_jen: If you pause the queue please give a 30m heads-up. We have 7 folks on afternoon shift and don't want to starve them.

curie-bot: deploy notice: provenance-repair v0.3 scheduled to run in staging (triggered by mira)

sam: SQL check to find dup fingerprints quickly: `SELECT fingerprint, COUNT(*) FROM samples WHERE snapshot='s-2026-03-20' GROUP BY fingerprint HAVING COUNT(*)>1;`

tony: Also: tag any eval runs with the snapshot id (s-2026-03-20) and the repair-run id so later comparisons are deterministic. This explains some of the weird regression noise we saw earlier.

mira: Agreed — I'll tag the canary eval and include the diff id. Running dry-run now, ETA ~45m.

nina: I'll create a calendar invite for a 30m triage at T+50m and include @labeler_jen @sam @tony @mira. Will also create the rollback snapshot ticket.

labeler_jen: :thumbsup: thanks, pls ping in #help when queue is paused so we can switch to other tasks.

mira: Quick interim update: dry-run found 123 missing provenance rows, 47 duplicate fingerprints, and 9 holdout rows that would have been dropped by the old dedupe unit. Proceeding with repair in dry-run mode only. Will post the final diff and planned repair command (no writes) once complete.

sam: thanks — if you need compute to run the infill, we can borrow one staging GPU pool for shorter runs.

mira: noted. will call if needed.

nina: perfect. we'll treat repaired snapshot as canary and gate any model onboarding/quant experiments on passing the canary checks.

mira: final: dry-run diff id: diff-snap-2026-03-20-08, items to repair: 170 (combine missing and dup fixes). scheduling repair in 1h if no blockers.

labeler_jen: OK, sounds good. keep us posted. :raised_hands:
